plain_description.what: On the CLINC intent dataset, uses the anchor-free tree's cells (139 leaves, built without labels) to flag out-of-scope queries. It compares this with flat k-means using the same number of clusters.
plain_description.why: It asks whether the tree can support abstention (saying "this question is outside what we cover") as well as flat clusters can.
plain_description.information: If equivalent, the tree can be used for both routing and abstention. Result: done. The two are equivalent within the ±0.01 margin. Tree cells are very slightly worse (about 0.005 lower detection score, a difference that is statistically real but tiny). One dataset, one embedder, one draw.
